locator: GoedelVariantHOML1.thy, Th3: "⌊❙◇(❙∃⇧Ex. G x) ❙⊃ ❙□(❙∃⇧Ey. G y)⌋"
interpretation: Theorem Th3 as stated in the theory, proved there from Th2 and Rsymm. The theory does not state that a God-like being possibly exists, so Th3 is its last existence theorem; the claim does not say the theory derives that a God-like being exists. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Gödel's 1970 manuscript (Benzmüller and Scott), not to what Gödel intended.
